question: Who was the Governor General of British India when the annexation of Punjab was carried out by the Britishers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord Dalhousie**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Treaty of Lahore pertains to the First Anglo-Sikh War (1846), not the Second.
 
• The annexation of Punjab happened in 1849, after the Second Anglo-Sikh War, under Lord Dalhousie.
 
• 29 March 1849 marks the formal annexation of Punjab but not a treaty.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lord Dalhousie **was **Governor-general of India from (1848-1856)**.

 
 
• He introduced the Policy of **Doctrine of Lapse** and annexation of** Satara(1848), Jhansi(1853), Nagpur(1854) and Udaipur(1852)**.
 
• He annexed **lower Burma** in the year **1852**.
 
• The introduction of **Wood's despatch on Education** in his tenure saw the opening of Government colleges and Anglo-vernacular schools.
 
• 1st **railway line** from **Bombay to Thane** was created in 1853.
 
• Passing of **Widow remarriage act of 1856**.
 
• Started of **Telegraph and Pwd** system during his tenure.
